name: Wanting More
overview: Scripture reveals a tension in the human desire for more, highlighting that while delighting in the Lord results in receiving the desires of the heart, unchecked greed and haste to gain wealth bring trouble and poverty. The eyes of man are never satisfied, likened to the insatiable nature of hell and destruction, yet God warns against laboring solely to be rich or withholding generosity. True contentment and life come from trusting God rather than pursuing riches through worldly wisdom or selfish ambition.
